sources.modifications: Complete row set reordered into a spatial hierarchy; luminosity-weighted proxies and 32-color display quantization. No astrometry propagation.

source.qualification: Local generated assets; no network publication. HYG astrometry is a local stellar neighbourhood, not a full Milky Way stellar census.

catalogueMetadata.sentinelDistDoc: dist == 100000.0 marks an unmeasurable/negative Hipparcos parallax; rows with it are dropped, not shipped.
catalogueMetadata.hipSentinelDoc: hip == 0 means the row has no Hipparcos catalogue number.

provenance.qualification: All catalogue rows retained at their recorded astrometry; no proper-motion propagation to the navigation epoch. Internal nodes approximate unresolved luminosity and position; no fixed pixel-error guarantee when the point pool is saturated.
